_note: What you see: the admin settings of Open Register: permission matrix with row rules and public read, features on and off, and log integrity.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: de beheerinstellingen van Open Register: rechtenmatrix met rij-regels en openbaar lezen, functies aan en uit, en logintegriteit.
Rechten per schema en groep. Rij-regels: Permissions per schema and group. Row rules limit which records someone sees; departments and roles come from the matrix per department.
Matrix per afdeling en rol gebruiken: Use matrix per department and role
Rechten volgen afdeling maal rol, bijvoo: Permissions follow department times role, for example Public space, case handler
Zet onderdelen per installatie aan of ui: Turn parts on or off per installation
Bewijs dat de audit trail niet achteraf: Proof that the audit trail was not changed afterwards
